title: a module a proof loads by path is in its seal's closure
intention: A seal's closure names every repo file the proof's run loaded, including a module loaded by path and never registered in sys.modules, so a change to that file moves the seal.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 in wt-1e99 on akiendelllinux. test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py loads cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py by importlib.util.spec_from_file_location + exec_module (_sail()). sail.py is therefore outside the closure read from sys.modules, and the commit-time reseal after fix f09284b4f reported the stale red seal settled without re-running it.
traces_to: Law 8 and Law 1: a seal is trusted because it moves when its subject moves; a settled answer is re-derived only when its inputs change, so the inputs must all be counted.
how: In the closure runner in cairn/devices/tester/device.py (the atexit dump of sys.modules that _read_closure reads), also record repo .py files loaded outside sys.modules, for example through an audit hook on 'open'/'compile' scoped to the repo. Proof: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_module_loaded_by_path_is_in_the_seals_closure.py, keyed PROVES '6e50ed204abc' clauses 1-2, with a fixture proof that loads a scratch-repo module by path.

outcomes.claim: a proof that loads a repo .py by spec_from_file_location + exec_module, without a sys.modules insert, seals a closure naming that file
after that file's bytes change, the reseal re-runs the proof instead of reporting it settled

constraints: The closure still names the proof itself, and _read_closure's guard against a closure that does not name its proof is unchanged.
734b22d09f2e's reach log (subprocess loads) is still unioned into the closure.

measured.saw: the commit-time reseal after f09284b4f reported the sail proof settled-red ('the closure has not moved'); an explicit bin/cairn test --seal ran it green
measured.how: build1e99.sh in wt-1e99 on akiendelllinux, then bin/cairn test --seal on the proof
